stem:
Adil counts six mangoes by matching each mango to one bead in order, from bead 1 through bead 6.

Which statement is correct?

options.text: The ordered bead sequence alone counts the mangoes even if some mangoes are left unmatched.
One-to-one matching works only when Hindu numerals are written on the beads.
Each mango is matched exactly once to one bead, so the ordered beads show that there are six mangoes.
Six is correct because the word six is the longest word Adil wrote beside the beads.

teacher.key_rationale: Counting without Hindu numerals still needs a one-to-one match of each object to one ordered tally mark. Skipping mangoes omits that match. Requiring written numerals swaps the tool for the matching idea. Picking the longest word grabs a surface feature.
